move: frosted pill floats over drifting blobs, shine sweeps, cursor press springs
how: An aurora background image and three 520px blurred colour blobs (pink, blue, teal) drift on yoyo sine tweens across the full 6s loop while a frosted-glass pill button with backdrop-filter blur floats up and down 6px. A skewed white gradient shine strip sweeps across the button from x 0 to 640 with power2.inOut over 1.3s starting at 0.4s and again at 3.9s. At 1.6s the cursor flies in with power3.out, the button scales to 1.05 and its star icon rotates 72deg with back.out(2); at 2.8s (47%) the press shrinks it to 0.96 with a white press overlay, and at 2.94s it springs back to 1.05 with elastic.out(1,0.45). The button eases back to 1 and the icon unwinds with power2.inOut at 3.8s while the cursor leaves. The yoyo repeat:1 on 3s tweens makes the blob drift return exactly to its start at 6s.
adapt: Replace the background image and blob colours, the label 'Get started' and the icon; keep the 22px backdrop blur and grain for the frosted look. Keep the two shine sweeps and the press at ~47% of the loop.
port: mount(el, shot) builds bg, three blobs, the glass button (hi, grain svg, shine, press overlay, icon, label) and the cursor inside el. animate returns the timeline with blob yoyo tweens of duration D/2, shine sweeps at 0.067D and 0.65D, press at 0.467D. The shine travel of 640px and cursor offsets should scale with the button width; scope selectors to el.
